content: If you’re looking for a new laptop or a gift for the student in your life, you can save $50 on the MacBook Neo at several retailers, in both storage sizes and all four colors. The 256GB model is currently discounted to $649 (Amazon, Best Buy, Target), while the 512GB model with Touch ID is down to $749 (Amazon, Best Buy, Target). None of the retailers currently list an end date for the discount, which is the biggest price drop we’ve seen since Apple raised the laptop’s MSRP by $100 in July in response to the ongoing RAM crisis. [Product: MacBook Neo | https://www.amazon.com/Apple-2026-MacBook-13-inch-Laptop/dp/B0GR685V9X?tag=theverge02-20, https://bestbuy.7tiv.net/c/482924/614286/10014?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bestbuy.com%2Fproduct%2F13-inch-macbook-neo-apple-a18-pro-chip-with-6core-cpu-and-5core-gpu-8gb-memory-256gb-ssd-silver%2FJJGCQYXSYR, https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GR6F79MT/?tag=theverge02-20] Apple’s budget-friendly MacBook leverages the A18 Pro processor, a chip originally found in the iPhone 16 Pro, to keep costs down. Both the 256GB and 512GB models feature 8GB of memory, and my colleague Antonio G. Di Benedetto was impressed by the vivid 13-inch screen and speakers, the latter of which are better than those in many cheap (and even midrange) Windows laptops. The Neo isn’t super performant, especially in terms of storage speed and total memory, but it’s great for everyday tasks, casual use, and students. Read our Apple MacBook Neo review.

chineseContent: 如果您正在为生活中的学生寻找一台新笔记本电脑或一份礼物，您可以在多家零售商处购买 MacBook Neo，以节省 50 美元，有存储尺寸和所有四种颜色可供选择。 256GB 型号目前折扣至 649 美元（亚马逊、百思买、Target），而带 Touch ID 的 512GB 型号则降至 749 美元（亚马逊、百思买、塔吉特）。目前没有一家零售商列出折扣的结束日期，这是自苹果公司在 7 月份将笔记本电脑的建议零售价提高 100 美元以应对持续的 RAM 危机以来我们看到的最大降价。 [产品：MacBook Neo | https://www.amazon.com/Apple-2026-MacBook-13-inch-Laptop/dp/B0GR685V9X?tag=theverge02-20， https://bestbuy.7tiv.net/c/482924/614286/10014?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bestbuy.com%2Fproduct%2F13-inch-m acbook-neo-apple-a18-pro-chip-with-6core-cpu-and-5core-gpu-8gb-memory-256gb-ssd-silver%2FJJGCQYXSYR， https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GR6F79MT/?tag=theverge02-20] 苹果的经济型 MacBook 利用 A18 Pro 处理器（最初在 iPhone 16 Pro 中使用的芯片）来降低成本。 256GB 和 512GB 型号均配备 8GB 内存，生动的 13 英寸屏幕和扬声器给我的同事 Antonio G. Di Benedetto 留下了深刻的印象，后者比许多廉价（甚至中端）Windows 笔记本电脑的扬声器要好。 Neo 的性能并不是非常出色，尤其是在存储速度和总内存方面，但它非常适合日常任务、休闲使用和学生。阅读我们的 Apple MacBook Neo 评论。
